Six merged PRs since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `lineItems` under `src`, all on the main line up to the pinned head `c770afca` (#885):

1. **#738** (O3-5413, Add bill refunds), merged 2026-06-04. New refund files add `lineItems` lines, such as `src/refunds/admin/review-bill-refunds/review-bill-refunds.utils.ts:31`.
2. **#732** (O3-5417, Add bill discounts), merged 2026-05-18. New discount files add `lineItems` lines, such as `src/discounts/discounts-table.component.tsx:26`.
3. **#741** (O3-5421, Visit-bills panel), merged 2026-06-02. The new `src/visit-bills/visit-bills-panel.component.tsx:46` contains `bill?.lineItems`.
4. **#733** (Update BillLineItem type), merged 2026-05-20. Its diff changes the `lineItems: [{ ... }]` line in `src/bill-history/bill-history.test.tsx:132`.
5. **#744** (O3-5708, Keep discount review modal open), merged 2026-05-25. Its re-indented block removes and re-adds `lineItems={lineItems}` in `src/discounts/admin/review-bill-discounts/review-bill-discounts.modal.tsx`.
6. **#885** (O3-6112, tablet patient header), merged 2026-10-15. Its re-indented block removes and re-adds `{bill.lineItems.map((item) => (` in `src/billing-form/billing-form.workspace.tsx`.

Several other PRs were checked and ruled out, including #717, #735, #743, #749, #751, #767, #769, #779, #780, #831 and #854. Two caveats:
- Falkon's `get_diff` output was too large to return inline, and reading the saved copy was denied, so I worked from per-file diffs of each candidate merge commit.
- Matching on file-level changes is less exhaustive than a full diff scan. Other PRs that were not inspected at line level (for example #808 and the #854 `src/index.ts` changes) are unlikely but not fully excluded.
